opening_partition: SHA256 ECO three-character family, or first four-ply sequence when absent; modulo 5: 0 adaptation, 1 calibration, otherwise final test. Shared opening-family assignment across sources.
selection: First 1000 valid complete standard game records per source, deterministic game-content hash order; retain earliest eligible games meeting preregistered split quotas. Position sampling spreads across the complete record, augmented by objectively defined special-move/endgame opportunities before any model evaluation.
leakage: Exclude historical and cross-game whole-position translation, reflection and color-swap equivalents; audit exact FEN and four-field canonical hashes. Shared local relational features are not independent knowledge.
frozen: Evaluate unchanged C8 checkpoint and Cycle 9 calibration on every external position before any external adaptation or calibration fitting.
adaptation: Nested subsets of 6 then 24 external adaptation games; revise only existing relative learner hypotheses using native revision and game/opening dependence. Final test never used for tuning or promotion.
calibration: Ten strength bins, Laplace smoothing; fit external calibration games only after frozen evaluation. 400 deterministic game-cluster bootstrap replicates.
native_composition: No new operator; architecture review only.
git_policy: Local commits only; no push or deployment.
